notes: Leaf 279 is printed p.273, the first page of Table XV Part II (Bi-lingualism) - the manifest's leaf ranges are off by one (Part I = leaves 272-278, Part II = leaves 279-282). Only Males/Females are printed. Amritsar, Punjabi -> Kashmiri, females: the first digit is broken and looks like '1' ('147'), but under 5x zoom it has the crossbar of a '4'; read as 447, which is what both the Amritsar Punjabi total (635 = 132 + 56 + 447) and the Lahore Division Kashmiri total (3,603 = 3,156 + 447) require; flagged as doubtful. Rawalpindi Division, Lahnda -> Pashto, males: the first digit of 3,374 is blotted; read as 3,374, which agrees with the district sum and with 3,442 - 68. Dujana, Punjabi Total/Hindustani females are printed as a single dot; treated as nil. Lahnda (Western Punjabi) continues on p.274 (leaf 280) with Balochi cols 23-24. On this leaf the Lahnda Total minus the Hindustani+Rajasthani+Pashto columns leaves exactly the Balochi figures to be expected on leaf 280: Punjab/British Territory 35,738 M, 21,930 F; Multan Division 35,738 M, 21,929 F; Dera Ghazi Khan 35,736 M, 21,910 F; Multan 1 M, 19 F; Muzaffargarh 1 M; Lahore Division/Lahore 1 F. All area sums (districts->division->British Territory->Punjab; states->A/B->Punjab States) check for every column.
